system.longDesc:
Capacity: 1 Slot

You have an engineered layer of subcutaneous fat, or a thick coat of fur or hair on your body, something that insulates you against the cold. You reduce the effects of cold-related hazards by 1d6 and gain a +2 bonus on tests to resist them.

Game modifiers on this item: consTest +2 (tests to resist cold hazards, off). Items apply their modifiers while equipped; switch the ones that are off on when they apply.
